description: Phase 5: Autonomy — self-healing config, meta-agent strategy selection, continual learning

userStories.title: Self-healing configuration updater
userStories.description: As the system operator, I need an autonomous config updater that detects performance degradation and adjusts thresholds without human intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/autonomy/self_heal_config.py exists with SelfHealConfigUpdater class
Monitors recent win rate, drawdown, and Sharpe ratio
Autonomously adjusts gate thresholds and risk parameters within safe bounds
Logs all changes with before/after values and trigger reason
Requires operator approval for changes outside reversible bounds
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-06-14. File: src/autonomy/self_heal_config.py. Tests: tests/test_self_heal_config.py (4/4 pass). Stress-tested: rapid updates, extreme PnL, zero variance, missing config keys. Fixed zero-variance Sharpe bug. 11 tests passing (7 unit + 4 stress).

userStories.title: Meta-agent for strategy selection
userStories.description: As the strategy layer, I need a meta-agent that dynamically selects which sub-strategy (trend, mean-reversion, momentum) to activate based on current regime.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/autonomy/meta_agent.py exists with MetaStrategyAgent class
Observes regime + recent performance of each sub-strategy
Selects top-K strategies to activate per scan cycle
Tracks selection accuracy and adapts selection weights
Graceful fallback to all-strategy ensemble when uncertain
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-06-14. File: src/autonomy/meta_agent.py. Tests: tests/test_meta_agent.py (4/4 pass). Stress-tested: regime flipping, exploration saturation, no observations, extreme PnL, tied scores. Fixed zero-division in weight normalization. 8 tests passing (4 unit + 4 stress).

userStories.title: Continual learning loop
userStories.description: As the learning system, I need a continual learning loop that updates models incrementally from new trades without catastrophic forgetting of older patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/autonomy/continual_learner.py exists with ContinualLearner class
Stores episodic memory of representative past trades
Replays old samples alongside new data during incremental updates
Elastic weight consolidation (EWC) or similar regularization
Tracks forgetting metric: performance on old validation set
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-06-14. File: src/autonomy/continual_learner.py. Tests: tests/test_continual_learner.py (7/7 pass). Stress-tested: memory overflow, NaN params, missing gradients, empty memory, rapid EWC updates. 11 tests passing (7 unit + 4 stress).
